answer: A pollinator-mapping co-op could renew voting identities through surveys of how bees wander between nectar patches along an inlet. Each account gets a disjoint walking route; weekly audits check continuous GPS-stamped video for route completion and reject duplicate coverage. One hour of fieldwork cannot credit two routes, so extra identities require extra work. Example: at 2 non-shareable fieldwork-hours per identity monthly, 12 identities require 24 fieldwork-hours per month.
